title: Discord bot
description: Discord's HTTP API, for one application's bot, whether it receives events over the gateway or interactions at an HTTP endpoint.

members.name: baseURL
members.description: HTTPS base URL of the Discord API; without it, the vendor's public one.

members.name: botToken
members.description: The bot's token, in the vendor's format, which is not validated.

members.name: applicationID
members.description: Identifier of the Discord application the bot belongs to.

members.name: publicKey
members.description: The application's public key, which verifies each interaction Discord sends to an HTTP endpoint.
